newsitem.title: USA: TresCom says gets new $25 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: TresCom says gets new $25 mln credit line.

text.p: TresCom International Inc said Tuesday that it arranged a five year asset-based facility with PNC Business Credit, a division of PNC Bank, for a credit line up to $25 million.
The new financing is available for working capital, acquisitions, and investments, a news release issued by TresCom said.

TresCom has previously announced that it is embarking on an expansion program throughout Central America and the Caribbean including investments in infrastructure such as undersea cable systems; establishing more satellite connectivity; and installing additional phone booths and call centers in target countries.
